usedFor: Phrase holds your translation jobs, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “Job Completed” in Phrase, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A completed job starts a command you chose on your computers, so the next step runs without you.

watchOut: “Job Completed” in Phrase is polling, so the command runs after a scheduled check, not the moment a job ends.
